newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - June 19.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - June 19.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:
* The Dow Jones industrial average ended down 42.07 points at 7,718.71 on Wednesday amid warnings of disappointing profits by technology companies.

* The World Bank said on Wednesday that Indonesia's current account deficit was likely to reach $10.1 billion, or four percent of gross domestic product (GDP), in the fiscal 1997-98 year (April-March).

* On Wednesday, the Jakarta composite index rose 5.7 points, or 0.81 percent, to close at 710.79 points on continued inflow of foreign funds, while the World Bank report on Indonesia received mixed reactions from the market, brokers and analysts said.
* On Thursday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,428.75/29.00 at 0140 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,427.75/28.50.
* Small-sized electronics firm Jeewon Jaya following a trading suspension on Wednesday due to a sudden sharp rise. The counter is expected to resume trading on Thursday.
* Pulp and rayon manufacturer Indorayon after an announcement that its subsidiary has completed acquisition of a Finland-based viscose fibres manufacturer.
* BDNI following strong gains on Wednesday on market talk that the bank was likely to acquire a privately-owned bank.

* Textile firm Roda Vivatex on market talk of a possible take-over and that the firm was likely to announce a rights issue. The firm has denied the rumours. Roda has made modest gains in active trading in the past several days due to the rumours.

* Toll road operator Citra Marga on its one-for-one rights issue announcement and an upward revision in its 1997 net profit forecast to 154 billion rupiah from the previous forecast of 145 billion rupiah.
* Barkie Finance Corporation on reports it planned to increase its stake in small sized bank PT Bank Nusa Internasional to 82 percent from 47 percent.
